name: openzeppelin-contracts
description_en: OpenZeppelin Contracts is a library for secure smart contract development.
readme_excerpt: A library for secure smart contract development. Build on a solid foundation of community-vetted code. Implementations of standards like ERC20 and ERC721. Flexible role-based permissioning scheme. Reusable Solidity components to build custom contracts and complex decentralized systems. :mage: Not sure how to get started?
